summary: The compact cottage massing and steep gable silhouette read clearly, but prominent surface and entrance details do not yet match the reference studio closely enough.

orientation.summary: SV1 is located southwest of the studio and looks NE, placing the camera against the +u (SE) and +v (SW) sides. It shows the white principal door on the SE gable end and a white-trimmed window on the adjacent SW wall. The labeled renders and door inventory correspond: the sole principal door is on +u, while +v carries the side window. No duplicate principal portal is present.

issues.problem: The walls are rendered with a pronounced brick pattern, while the reference buildings have brown shingle or simple wood-clad walls.
issues.fix: Replace the brick texture with restrained brown shingle/wood siding at a miniature-friendly scale.

issues.problem: The reference has a pale standing-seam metal roof, but the model uses gray asphalt-style shingles, including an overly dark roof on the reviewed studio.
issues.fix: Use a light silver-gray metal roof with subtle vertical seams and modest overhangs.

issues.problem: The principal door reads as a plain opaque brown/tan slab; the visible reference entrance is white and has a large divided-light glazed upper section.
issues.fix: Make the +u door white and add simplified divided-light glazing while retaining the small steps and trim.
